name: @kiwa/solidstart
description: SolidStart Server Functions + API Routes test adapter for kiwa — invoke `'use server'` async functions + `routes/api/*.ts` handlers with simulated APIEvent and capture Response without a running SolidStart dev server (part of the kiwa test framework family)

scripts.test: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
scripts.test:cov: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node --coverage --coverage.provider=v8 --coverage.reporter=json --coverage.reporter=json-summary --coverage.reporter=text --coverage.reportsDirectory=coverage --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/invoke-server-function.js' --coverage.include='.vitest-dist/src/invoke-api-route.js' --coverage.exclude='.vitest-dist/tests/**' --coverage.exclude='.vitest-dist/src/index.js'
